appearance.subtle: They feel solid in a way that does not match their build.
appearance.obvious: A grey membrane shows at their collar and cuffs, sitting under the skin like a second garment.
appearance.extreme: Their whole body is sheathed in a dense grey membrane, hardened into visible plates over the heart and the belly and the throat.

description: A dense flexible membrane has grown between your skin and everything under it. It moves like you do and it stops most of what reaches you.
drawbacks: You are heavier than you look
name: Biological Armor
